market_definition: The carbon foam market comprises porous carbon or graphite foams with high thermal conductivity, low density and fire resistance. It measures sales of carbon foam blocks, panels and parts. BY PRECURSOR: Pitch-Based, Coal-Based, Polymer / Other. BY PRODUCT FORM: Blocks, Panels, Machined Parts. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Aerospace & Defense, Thermal Management & Heat Exchangers, Energy Storage & Electrodes, Industrial Insulation, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Carbon fibre and composites; graphite sheets; syntactic and ceramic foams. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
